findings: G-009: mandatory Format → 格式化 has a capitalization/lexical-family semantic collision with lowercase format used broadly as a noun in Learn/Docs (for example connection-string format, file format, encoding format, version format). The Tour UI label decision is not safe as an unqualified global mandatory rule.

G-010: keep Go collides with ordinary English usage in current Tour source such as 'Where to Go from here...'; bare Go cannot safely represent a context-dependent language-brand identity across all translatable natural-language regions.

G-011: keep goroutines and Goroutines over-constrain English plural/capitalization forms even though formal zh-CN terminology authority defines canonical identity goroutine and explicitly says keep does not require preserving English grammatical suffixes.
G-012: mutex is missing from the locale glossary despite formal zh-CN terminology authority mutex → 互斥锁 and current Tour/SEO source occurrences.
